about: A row has id, part, section, sentence and audience.

sentences.sentence: Node '<id>' in <path> reuses the id of node '<id>' <at the top level | in <other path>>, which <path> can read: rename one. Ids may repeat only where neither can see the other (for example in two sibling loops).
While '<id>' declares max <n>; a while runs at most FormatBounds.passes (15) passes.
